svg.text: Flow 02 Staff and admin sign-in and page access
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
Save the token and user on
• The code works for 10 minutes and allows 5 wrong tries; Send a new code waits 60 seconds, at most 3 times per
sign-in and 10 emails an hour per account. Only a hash of the code is stored, and it works once. If the email
can't be sent, sign-in stops with “We couldn't send your sign-in code”.
• Every API request is checked again on the server (authorize("admin") or authorize("admin", "staff")), so the
page checks only decide what is shown.
• The access token lasts 15 minutes and is renewed in the background with the 7-day refresh cookie. Each renewal
re-reads the account, so a suspended or demoted user loses access at the next renewal. If renewal fails, the
next request sends the user back to the login page.
• Log out clears the saved token and the refresh cookie and opens the login page.
